messages:
hannah: quick thread to propose the 'synthetic_sentinel_v2' gate for v4q-longdoc onboarding. idea: one compact index that captures coherence + hallucination + tail-latency + infra warmup signals so we can do principled autofallbacks.

leo: nice. i like a single index rather than a bunch of ad-hoc rules. what signals?

hannah: signals: concordance_score_delta (higher is worse), ner_halluc_pct, latency_p99_ms (absolute + pct uplift), kv_warm_miss_per_1k (cache warmup), tokens_per_session_delta. normalize and weight. trigger when risk_index >= 0.78 sustained over window.

mina: add a small answer-coherence metric (BLEU-ish ngram overlap vs reference) for multi-turns. v4 shows subtle fluency that MRR misses.

hannah: good call. i'll add answer_coherence_delta as low-weight input. default weights: concordance:0.45, ner_halluc:0.2, latency:0.18, kv_warm_miss:0.1, tokens:0.05, coherence:0.02. seq_len adjustments: for >2500 tokens multiply latency weight x1.6 and reduce concordance weight x0.9.

raj: safety preconds? tiny cohorts are noisy. require either canary_traffic_pct >= 1.8% OR num_slices_firing >= 3 for auto-rollback. otherwise just alert to #eng-ml.

hannah: agreed. also two-tier thresholds: alert_score=0.65 (10m smoothing), soft-auto=0.9 (3m sustained) for first 4h, then auto threshold decays to 0.8 afterwards. ops prefer conservative autos early.

taylor: can you paste the compact policy blob so infra/orch can accept it directly? devex wants per-signal contribution exposed in Console for triage.

hannah: pasted below. it's the staging draft for the orchestration API.

```json
{
  "name": "synthetic_sentinel_v2",
  "inputs": ["concordance_delta","ner_halluc_pct","latency_p99_ms","latency_pct_uplift","kv_warm_miss_per_1k","tokens_delta_pct","answer_coherence_delta"],
  "weights": {"concordance_delta":0.45,"ner_halluc_pct":0.2,"latency_p99_ms":0.18,"kv_warm_miss_per_1k":0.1,"tokens_delta_pct":0.05,"answer_coherence_delta":0.02},
  "normalize":"robust_scale",
  "latency_rule": {"abs_p99_ms":420,"pct_uplift_threshold":0.22},
  "context_adjust": [{"if":"seq_len>2500","apply":{"latency_mul":1.6,"concordance_mul":0.9}}],
  "thresholds": {"alert_score":0.65,"soft_auto_score":0.9,"post_watch_auto_score":0.8,"alert_window_min":10,"soft_auto_window_min":3},
  "preconds": {"min_canary_pct":1.8,"min_slices_firing":3},
  "actions": {"on_alert":["notify:#eng-ml","attach:per_signal_series"],"on_soft_auto":["notify:#oncall","escalate_if_persistent"],"on_auto":["rollback","create_incident:severity=high"]}
}
```

leo: nit: absolute p99 420ms might be tight for some regions; we should have region-aware baselines (console can allow region overrides). also prefer evictions_per_1k naming (kv_warm_miss_per_1k is fine).

mina: synthetic eval set: include a 200-item halluc-prone entity set + 150 multi-turn longchat examples + a tiny shadow of customer long-docs (opt-in). that will surface signals faster.

ops-bot: deploy: canary start for model:v4q-longdoc at 2026-03-24T09:40:00Z cohort=0.5%. hooks: concordance_delta, ner_halluc_pct, latency_p99_ms, latency_pct_uplift, kv_warm_miss_per_1k, tokens_delta_pct, answer_coherence_delta.

raj: plan: push sentinel to staging with the two-tier thresholds, require safety preconds for auto, and wire Console to show stacked per-signal contribution + running risk_index. i will also add a debug opt-in to emit per-request signal vector for the canary cohort to S3 for triage.

hannah: pushing to staging now. will post the staging config link + 25m shadow snapshot when the synthetic run finishes. thanks all :thumbsup:
